content.description: Begin is the next-generation of Cardano Wallets, that enables you to enter the new era of finance. Enjoy an easy onboarding process that guides you step-by-step. Welcome! Earn up to 5% rewards staking your ADA and have full control of it. Helping to secure the Cardano network. Also, you are completely free to withdraw and move it any time. Begin opens the door to the DeFi world to you, from swapping Native Token direct on the wallet, to collecting NFTs. Get more from the vibrant Cardano DeFi with DEXs, NFT Marketplaces and more.
